# Leaflet 1.9.4

Unmodified official distribution downloaded 2026-11-13 from
https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/releases/download/v1.9.4/leaflet.zip
(official release: https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/releases/tag/v1.9.4).
The exact upstream BSD 2-Clause LICENSE is included from
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/v1.9.4/LICENSE.
All distributed JS, CSS, referenced source maps and marker/layer images are
retained. Individual byte counts and SHA-256 hashes are in catalog/map-data.json.
No runtime CDN requests are needed.
